name: ultimate-frame
description: Rounded corners, strokes, shadows, crop, edge fade and backing for every scene, animated with the scene transitions.
long_description: A filter that rounds the corners of a source and adds an inner and outer border (solid or gradient), a drop or inner shadow, crop, zoom, an edge fade and a backing fill. Each scene can have its own look, animated with Move, Fade or Cut. Sizes are in canvas pixels. Comes with the Fade for Ultimate Frame transition.
